title: Kissed Light Filipino Chicken Tinola
description: A light and fermented Filipino dish featuring chicken stock cube and render fat, perfect for a quick meal prep. This ovo-vegetarian friendly recipe is a twist on the classic tinola.
instructions: In a large pot, heat the render fat over medium heat.
Add the sliced ginger and cook until fragrant.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the chopped onion and cook until translucent.
Add the chicken breast and cook until browned on all sides.
Add the chicken stock cube and 2 cups of water, then bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer for 10 minutes.
Add the fresh spinach and sliced green chili, then cook until the spinach is wilted.
Slice the hard boiled egg and add it to the pot.
Season with fish sauce if desired, then serve hot.
Cook poultry to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F before serving.
